header.title: Create Offer for Existing Merchant
header.subtitle: Use this form to create a new offer for a merchant already registered on the Qatar Living Deals platform. Select the merchant from the dropdown below to get started.

dealDetails.categoryHelper: • Choose the most suitable category to ensure your reward is listed correctly.
dealDetails.durationTooltip: How long this deal stays active on the platform. E.g., "3 months", "6 weeks", or "1 year".
dealDetails.redemptionTooltip: Choose "Unlimited" to let customers use this deal as many times as they want, or "Limited" to set a maximum per customer.
dealDetails.twoTranches: Is this deal valid for two tranches?
dealDetails.multipleItems: This Deal is for Multiple Items
dealDetails.multipleItemsInfo: If your deal is for multiple items, the price won't show on the deal card and details page.
dealDetails.specificDaysHelper: If your deal is valid only on specific days, please select them. Otherwise, it will be active every day.

description.title: Title
description.helper: • Clearly mention the deal, validity, and terms so users understand what's included.

merchant.helper: Select an existing merchant from the list. Start typing to search.
